newsitem.title: USA: Roberts sees breakeven Q4 oper earnings.
newsitem.headline: Roberts sees breakeven Q4 oper earnings.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said on Tuesday it expects to break even in the fourth quarter, based on continuing operations and before unusual items.
The results would beat forecasts by analysts, which projected a flat to modestly improved quarter compared with its third quarter, Roberts said. It did not further detail the analysts' estimates.
In the 1996 third quarter, Roberts had a net loss from operations of $3.1 million or $0.16 a share.
Fourth quarter 1996 revenues from continuing operations should be more than $30 million compared with revenues from continuing operations of $21.7 million in the third quarter, it said.
